person.description: Man with tousled brown hair and stubble, rolled-sleeve blue denim jacket with golden stitching and back hem buttons, cream shirt hem, tan trousers, brown shoes, holding a RED leash in his right hand. A small tan-and-white floppy-eared beagle with red collar walks alongside his right, facing away upper-right. Preserve man AND entire dog AND connected leash.
person.extra: Keep the entire small beagle at the man's right, same size, same distance and rear orientation, and the red leash connected from right hand to dog's collar. Keep the leash-holding hand near its original position rather than swinging widely. Dog takes a natural four-legged walking step with alternating paws; no sitting, floating or duplicated legs. Keep all paws and tail inside generous transparent margins.
phaseExtras: Dog: screen-left hind paw lifts from its trailing position; screen-right hind paw supports underneath. Keep body and collar position steady.
Dog: screen-left hind paw swings forward underneath the rump, partly hidden by body; screen-right hind leg straight supports. Front paws take the complementary walking step.
Dog: screen-left hind paw reaches forward low; screen-right hind paw begins pushing back. Keep body at the same position.

Dog: opposite contact to original: screen-right hind paw trails back toward lower right with paw pad visible; screen-left hind paw is forward beneath its rump. Swap the front paw supports correspondingly. Keep dog torso, head and tail size and orientation unchanged.
